events.title: A Sheltered Grove
events.description: Firelight in the branches. Farmers wave you down.

events.title: Wayhouse Signal
events.description: A patched lantern swings from a signal post.

events.title: Refugee Column
events.description: Cold hands, warm hearts. They ride with you a while.

events.title: Scrapfield Rails
events.description: Old rolling stock, gutted. Rich pickings for a workshop.

events.title: Silent Pylons
events.description: A dead grid, still humming. Wire it up briefly.

events.title: Broken Signal Yard
events.description: Tangled rails, tangled dispatchers. Someone hums.

events.title: Hollow Cut
events.description: The rails vanish into a pale, chewing throat.

events.title: Shrike Nest
events.description: Somebody is watching. Everyone is watching.
